access.summary: White Mountain National Forest land. The Forest Service allows hunting on all WMNF land, including Wilderness, under state regulations.
restrictions: No discharge within 150 yards of a residence, building, campsite, developed recreation site or occupied area.
No shooting across or on a Forest Service road or an adjacent body of water.
Private inholdings inside the forest need landowner permission.

properties.management_status: Fully protected, mostly natural, some limited uses

access.summary: State park or forest owned by NH DNCR. State rule Res 7301.10 allows hunting on these properties except a short list of named sites, none in Coos County.
restrictions: No firearm discharge within 300 ft of occupied developed areas such as campgrounds, beaches and playgrounds.
Portable tree stands only, Aug 1 - Jan 31, no nails or damage to trees. No permanent stands.
Baiting only by Fish and Game permit.
